question: An advanced science and technology expert recommended by the Minister of Education applies for an E-1 visa through Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Case 2). How long is the visa valid and how long can they stay?
reference: A multiple-entry visa valid for the period of stay, and the period of stay is granted for up to 5 years.
answer: For an advanced science and technology expert applying under Case 2 of the E-1 visa, the multiple-entry visa is valid for their period of stay [1]. The periods of stay granted can be up to 5 years [1].

A person who meets the qualifications stated in the 「Higher Education Act」, and plans to engage in education or research·guidance of the professional field at educational institutions of higher than the college level or any of the equivalents

## Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application

### Visa Issuance Confirmation (CCVI) application — Case 1

#### Eligibility
You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are

The head of a university (i.e. chancellor, or dean), a professor, associate professor, assistant professor, lecturer with concurrent posts, honorary professor, visiting scholar, or an exchange professor who plans to teach or research at a community college or above for at least 91 days.

1. A chancellor or dean refers to the head of a university who is hired by a prescribed procedure and oversees school affairs and faculties, and teaches students
2. A professor, associate professor, or assistant professor refers to an instructor whose qualification is acknowledged by the Human Resources Committee or Teacher’s Personnel Committee of a respective university, or who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act, and teaches and guides students and conduct academic research.
3. A lecturer with concurrent posts refers to a lecturer who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act and who has expertise in the relevant field
4. A honorary professor refers to a professor who has made remarkable achievements in education and academics ,and who has been designated by the enforcement decree of the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
5. A visiting scholar refers to a professor who meets the requirements set forth as Article 16 of the Higher Education Act (However, if the school hires him/her for a specific class, he/she does not have to meet the requirements.)
6. Exchange professor refers to a professor dispatched to a university in ROK from a foreign university in accordance with the exchange agreement between the two universities.

① Application form for Confirmation of Visa Issuance (Form No. 21), a copy of passport, a photo in a standard format

question: My husband is applying for an E-1 professor visa as an e-visa. Can I apply for an F-3-1 dependent visa as an e-visa too, and how many entries and how long a stay would I get?
reference: Yes. The spouse of an E-1 applicant is eligible for the F-3-1 e-visa, and a dependent family member is granted the same number of entries and length of stay as the principal applicant. The E-1 e-visa is single-entry with a stay of up to 1 year, so you would get a single-entry visa with a stay of up to 1 year.
answer: Yes, you are eligible to apply for an F-3-1 dependent visa as an e-visa if your husband is an E-1 professor applicant [2]. As a dependent family member, you will be granted the same number of entries and the length of stay as your principal applicant [1]. For e-visa applications, the period of stay is initially granted for up to 1 year [3].

question: A Vietnamese national living in Vietnam has an E-9-5 Confirmation of Visa Issuance and is about to apply for the visa at the Korean embassy. Do they have to submit a TB test certificate, and which one?
reference: Yes. The E-9-5 stay is long-term (up to 1 year) and Vietnam is a high TB-burden country, so they must submit a Certificate of Health including a TB test result, issued by a hospital designated by the Korean diplomatic mission and valid for one year, when applying for the visa at the mission. This also applies to applicants who hold a Visa Issuance Confirmation.
answer: A Vietnamese national living in Vietnam applying for an E-9-5 visa at a Korean embassy must submit a TB test certificate because Vietnam is on the list of high TB-burden countries [1]. The required document is a "Certificate of Health" including a TB test result issued by a hospital designated by Korean diplomatic missions, which must be valid for one year [1]. This certificate must include at least one of the following tests: chest X-ray, sputum test, tuberculin skin test, or blood test [1]. The Vietnamese national is not exempt from this requirement because they do not fall under the categories of diplomats, children aged 5 and under, non-professional or maritime crew visa holders who submitted certificates after March 2, 2016, marriage migrants with status granted after March 2, 2016, or short-term status holders applying for extensions [1]. The E-9-5 visa holder must submit this certificate as a supporting document when applying for the e-visa, and the same rule applies to visa applications at diplomatic missions [4].

question: According to the e-visa issuance confirmation, by when must an e-visa holder enter Korea, and does the e-visa guarantee entry?

question: My husband is applying for an E-1 professor visa as an e-visa. Can I apply for an F-3-1 dependent visa as an e-visa too, and how many entries and how long a stay would I get?

※ Yet, those who acquired a degree (credential) from a Korean uninversity or others are allowed to submit a diploma without official certification ( Copies will be stored after verfication with the original diploma and the records on the Immigration Control Information System)

- As for graduates from a vocational high school for which Verification/Credentials Report of a degree or others is not available,

ⅰ) For a diploma issued by a relevant school, confirmation by Provincial Office of Education (or Municipal Bureau of Education) and a Korean consul stationed in China is necessary, or

ⅱ) For a diploma issued by Provincial Office of Education (or Municipal Bureau of Education), confirmation by a Korean consul stationed in China is necessary to review the highest degree or level of education

⑤ Original copy of document proving your financial statement*

* In principle, documents proving your financial abilities must be reviewed through original copies (ex, bank statement, bankbook, scholarship receipt, deposit/withdrawal statement), and when necessary, a duplicate copy can be attached after an official-in-charge compares the original copy and duplicate copy to confirm authenticity (bank statement is only accepted when it is issued within the past 30 days)

※ When submitting a parents bank statement, family relation certificate must be attached.

⑥ Training Plan (Lecture Schedule, Lecturers Profiles, Training Facility and etc.)

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

### Visa validity and period of stay
You can apply for a single-entry visa valid for 3 months.
Periods of stay for this visa will be granted initially for up to 6 months.
For more information on Alien Registration or Visa extension, please visit Hi Korea website at www.hikorea.go.kr.
